Title: Kunal's Day

Cast

1. Kunal - 10 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Neeta - 38 years, mother
Look: green saree
3. Anil - 43 years, father
Look: glasses, brown sweater

Places

1. The road - a paved road, trees along it
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Neeta stands near him.]

Kunal: "Let's do something fun today."

[Kunal rides his bicycle down the road.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal gets on the bus.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal pedals his bicycle hard up the road.]

Kunal (happily): "What next?"

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

Anil: "Neeta, look over here."

[Kunal dances to the music.]

Kunal (softly): "Mom, look at this."

[Kunal claps his hands.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Kunal hugs Mother tightly.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Kunal: "Slowly, take it easy."

[The sun rises over the village.]

Kunal: "That was fun!"

[Kunal lights a bonfire.]

Neeta: "That was such a fun day!"
